about.heroH1:
I don't just come up with ideas.

about.bgP1: Brazilian-born. Miami-based. Two years living and working in the UK. I bring a multicultural lens to brand strategy — and a lifelong instinct for finding the most powerful new tool and using it to fuel bigger ideas.
about.bgP2: My career spans the full arc of digital marketing — from Flash campaigns before Y2K at Isobar to building one of the first AI chatbots for branded commercial marketing in 2006 (Dado Spitze for Bavaria Premium Beer at Euro RSCG), to creative direction at Y&R, to founding Samba Rock and its innovation lab (iLab), to building AI-powered intelligence tools that fuel brand strategy today.
about.bgP3: Today I operate through Chameleon Collective and Soundcheck Insights — bringing creative leadership, AI-powered intelligence, and an elite network of practitioners directly into client organizations.

intelligence.productsH2: One foundation. Four specialized modules. Built to fit your challenge.

products.headline: The research base that powers every module in your engagement.
products.title: Market Research
products.sub: Every Soundcheck engagement begins with a structured Market Research foundation — three written reports plus a research-grounded persona panel (6 to 20 personas across Mini, Standard, or Premium tiers). This is the evidence base that fuels every add-on module.
deliverables: Report A — Market Analysis: category sizing (TAM/SAM/SOM), channel architecture, category dynamics, communication codes and semiotics
Report B — Consumer Analysis: 5–6 consumer clusters with motivation frameworks, cultural insights, and sentiment matrix
Report C — Competitive Landscape: traffic-light matrix (7 competitors × 9 dimensions), perceptual map, and whitespace analysis
6–20 research-grounded personas built from your specific market, audience, and competitive context
Three tier options (Mini · Standard · Premium) sized to the question being asked

products.headline: Decision-grade market entry intelligence with a proprietary viability score.
products.title: GoGlobal Viability Analysis
products.sub: For brands considering geographic expansion — international brands entering the US, or US brands evaluating Mexico, UK, EU, or LATAM. Produces the proprietary CVE Score (Coefficient of Viability of Expansion), an 8-section report covering market opportunity, competitive position, consumer readiness, investment estimates, three strategic paths, and a 30/60/90-day action plan.
deliverables: CVE Score — Coefficient of Viability of Expansion: 0–100 proprietary score across Market Opportunity (40%), Competitive Position (35%), and Internal Readiness (25%)
8-section report: executive summary, brief, market analysis, competitive landscape, consumer readiness, persona profiles, CVE breakdown, and actionable items
Three strategic paths (Conservative / Balanced / Aggressive) with recommended path called out
30/60/90-day actionable items with risk frame for the target market
Executive presentation with Q&A session

products.headline: Structural readiness audit with a proprietary score, verdict band, and 24-month phased plan.
products.title: Scale Assessment
products.sub: For companies pushing from $5M to $50M, raising a round, or hitting a growth plateau. Produces the proprietary SRS Score (Scale-Readiness Score) with a verdict band — Scale-Ready, Scale-Conditional, Growth-Only, or Restructure — plus a 24-month phased plan and 90-day post-delivery monitoring framework.
deliverables: SRS Score — Scale-Readiness Score: 0–100 across Structural Foundation (40%), Market Position (35%), and Scale Capacity (25%) with verdict band
8-section report: operational readiness assessment naming what breaks first, growth blockers, capability gaps, and market expansion opportunities
24-month phased plan (Foundation → Activate → Accelerate → Compound) with go/no-go gates
Risk Frame at Scale: what changes when you 3× volume, headcount, or geography
90-day post-delivery AI-augmented monitoring framework

products.headline: Six-stage journey maps with brand-touchpoint audit for each persona.
products.title: Customer Journey Mapping
products.sub: Built on the personas defined in your Market Research foundation. Each journey map traces six stages — awareness, consideration, purchase, onboarding, retention, and advocacy — with a brand-touchpoint audit scoring your presence as PRESENT, PARTIAL, or ABSENT at each stage.
deliverables: Per-persona journey maps across six stages: awareness → consideration → purchase → onboarding → retention → advocacy
Brand-touchpoint audit: PRESENT / PARTIAL / ABSENT scoring at every stage for your brand vs. competitors
Cross-persona Gap Analysis: where your customer experience breaks down across different segments
Content and messaging recommendations aligned to each journey stage
Conversion barriers and friction points with recommended interventions

products.sub: AI-generated personas built from your Market Research foundation respond to your stimuli — creative concepts, product ideas, pricing, packaging, positioning. intelligence.whyH2: Not a research firm. Not a ChatGPT prompt. A structured intelligence engine with a human validation layer.
intelligence.whySub: Traditional market research costs $30K–$80K and takes 3–6 months. ChatGPT gives you unstructured output with no source hierarchy. I deliver something in between — structured, sourced, confidence-labeled, and validated by experience — in 7–14 days.

whyItems.title: Source-Tiered, Not Invented
whyItems.desc: Every claim is sourced from a four-tier hierarchy: government and official data first, then syndicated research, then industry associations, then web and media — explicitly flagged when primary sources aren't available.

whyItems.title: Claim-Typed and Confidence-Labeled
whyItems.desc: Every major finding is tagged as FACT, ESTIMATE, or INTERPRETATION — with HIGH, MED, or LOW confidence and the rationale behind it. You always know what you're looking at.

whyItems.title: Expert-Validated, Not Auto-Generated
whyItems.desc: AI does the research aggregation. I apply 28 years of cross-cultural brand experience to validate, contextualize, and translate findings into strategy you can act on.

whyItems.title: Modular, Not Monolithic
whyItems.desc: Start with the research foundation, add the modules that match your specific challenge. Every engagement is composed to fit — not a one-size-fits-all package with deliverables you don't need.

intelligence.ctaH2: Tell me what you need to know.
intelligence.ctaSub: I'll respond within 24 hours with a proposal — or a call to discuss the right starting point.

privateEquity.seoDescription: A transformation partner for private equity, from diligence to exit. International expansion and commerce growth that survives to exit, inside the Chameleon Collective model.
privateEquity.seoDefaultTitle: Valter Klug — Fractional CMO & Brand Expansion Strategist
privateEquity.heroH1: Expansion and commerce growth your buyer keeps.
privateEquity.heroSub: I lead international expansion and commerce transformation inside Chameleon Collective's diligence-to-exit model. A transformation expense with an end date, not an agency retainer that compounds.
privateEquity.thesisH2: The agency you hire at entry is the growth that walks out at exit.
privateEquity.agencyCurveText: Retainers compound quarter after quarter. The capability is rented. When the agency leaves, the growth leaves with it, and your buyer pays for a dependency.
privateEquity.chameleonCurveText: The spend has an end date. We transform the function, recruit the permanent team, and internalize the capability. EBITDA improves because we refuse to become overhead. At exit, the business runs itself.
privateEquity.fitH2: I own the deals with a new-market or commerce thesis.
privateEquity.fitSub: Chameleon is the machine across the whole deal lifecycle. My seat is the growth thesis I have spent 28 years executing, in both directions across the U.S. and Latin America.
privateEquity.crossBorderText: Building brands into new markets, U.S. to Latin America and back. Bauducco's U.S. national launch. Inter&Co's 2022 U.S. entry. The corridor most operators have never worked, in both directions.
privateEquity.commerceText: The e-commerce engine that turns a brand into direct sales. I built the first two U.S. storefronts on VTEX in 2019, two years before its U.S. IPO, and run Amazon and DTC on Shopify and BigCommerce.
privateEquity.lifecycleH2: One partner, from diligence to exit.

steps.title: Diligence
steps.text: Before you wire the money. Chameleon's CLEAR assessment puts C-level operators into the business and returns a plain read on where the growth blockers are. I add a quantified market-viability layer through Soundcheck Insights, my market-intelligence platform, so an expansion thesis gets a number before you commit capital.

steps.title: The first hundred days
steps.text: Interim marketing and commerce leadership in the seats that matter, while you search for the permanent hire. The growth engine gets stood up fast.

steps.title: The hold period
steps.text: The expansion and commerce theses executed, not just planned. Brand, DTC, marketplace, and AI-enabled marketing operations, injected exactly where the thesis needs them.

steps.title: Exit readiness
steps.text: We recruit the permanent team, hand off everything we built, and leave. Your buyer finds a self-sustaining business, not a dependency to unwind.

privateEquity.calloutText: Most partners find out if an expansion thesis works after they have paid for it. I put a number on it during diligence. Soundcheck Insights scores cross-border viability and scale readiness, and it plugs straight into CLEAR, so your value-creation plan starts with evidence instead of a hunch.
privateEquity.myWorkText: Bauducco's U.S. launch, Inter&Co's U.S. market entry, and the first U.S. e-commerce storefronts on VTEX. Brand and commerce outcomes across consumer, fintech, and DTC.
privateEquity.contactSub: Whether you are mid-diligence or mid-hold, let's talk. I will tell you honestly where we can move the number, and where you would not need me.

months.title: Month 1 — Intelligence
months.desc: We start with data, not guesses. Your engagement opens with a full Market Research foundation through Soundcheck Insights — competitive landscape, consumer analysis, and research-based personas for your specific category in the US. We also align on the strategic framework through A.M.P., my growth and positioning playbook (included as a gift, in Portuguese).
months.outcome: You leave month 1 with a clear, data-backed picture of the US opportunity.

months.title: Months 2–3 — Strategy
months.desc: Every major decision gets made here — positioning, go-to-market, pricing, channel strategy, entity structure — all grounded in the intelligence from month 1. I introduce you to the US professionals you'll need: logistics, legal, tax, import/export, sales. This is also when you can add a GoGlobal Viability Analysis for a formal expansion roadmap.
months.outcome: A go-to-market plan you can execute against, plus connections to the people who will help you execute it.

months.title: Months 4–6 — Execution Support
months.desc: Calls shift from planning to real-time troubleshooting and accountability. I help you navigate the inevitable surprises — customs delays, retailer pushback, cultural missteps, hiring challenges — and make additional introductions as specific needs emerge.
months.outcome: Confidence that the plan works, relationships with the right professionals, and the ability to continue independently.
